g.text: Same identifiable size–query cells for all nine models. Configured model order is preserved; no claim of a statistically significant winner.

g.text: Primary common panel: no reported invalid skill for any model. n counts shared size–query cells, not independent query IDs; repeated queries remain clustered.

g.text: One gold skill per query: Recall = Hit rate; MRR = MAP. Precision = Recall/K. 95% intervals and sensitivity are in common_panel_summary.csv.
